name: exif-privacy-cleaner
description: See what your photos give away before you share them — GPS location, phone or camera model, the time taken, software, comments, XMP/IPTC and PNG text — and write clean copies with all of it removed, or only the location. JPEG, PNG and WebP are cleaned without re-encoding, so quality is untouched, colours stay right and portrait photos stay upright. Originals are never changed. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 分享照片前，先看看照片里藏了什么——GPS 位置、手机或相机型号、拍摄时间、软件、备注、XMP/IPTC 和 PNG 文本——然后导出清除了这些信息（或只清除位置）的副本。JPEG、PNG、WebP 不重新压缩，画质不变、颜色不变，竖拍照片也不会变横。原图绝不改动。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
